pinev: 1902 Fergus Falls city directory: 'Trommler, Frederick W., res s end Mill st', matching the Ugeblad's 'Mill Str. syd' (1903). Pin at the south end of S Mill St where it meets W Alcott Ave (OSM intersection, read on the PC); the 1903 Sanborn shows Mill St ending at Alcott Ave.
No house number, so the circle covers the south end of the street; spelling and first name vary between sources.

tw-mn-fergus-falls-trombler-1903.t: The 1902 directory puts the Trommler house at the south end of Mill St; no number.
src: Fergus Falls city directory, 1902 (Ancestry U.S. City Directories)
